title: Many Predictors
summary: Multiple regression: coefficients that hold the other predictors constant, standardised betas, R² change between blocks like SPSS's hierarchical regression, VIF and residual plots.
hints: `base <- lm(efficacy_t3 ~ efficacy_t1, data = pd)` and `model <- lm(efficacy_t3 ~ efficacy_t1 + workload_hours + years_teaching, data = pd)`.
`anova(base, model)` tests the R² change; `summary(model)$r.squared - summary(base)$r.squared` is the change itself. `standardize_parameters(model)` gives the betas.
`vif(model)` from car. Diagnostics: `plot(model, which = 1)` (residuals vs fitted) and `plot(model, which = 2)` (Q–Q).
